newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ipswich West Moreton to change name.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ipswich West Moreton to change name.

text.p: Queensland's oldest credit union Ipswich & West Moreton Building Society said on Tuesday it will change its name to First Provincial Building Society following approval for a merger with its First Provincial competitor.
Shareholders will vote on the agreed merger on October 23 with November 4 the expected starting date for the new group, Ipswich & West Moreton chairman Neal Axelby told reporters.
Axelby said the merged group would have double the current market share of the two societies and become the second-largest society in the state and eighth-biggest in Australia.
"We are working on a four to five-year growth strategy and are looking to increase our asset size to about A$1 billion which is achievable in the medium term," Axelby said.
The combined current asset base is A$560 million.
First Provincial shareholders are being offered alternatives which include a 9-for-10 share swap, a share buy-back offer or retaining their First Provincial shares.
